sections.title: The lead that did not convert

items.q: What does Primeagen say Google spends, and where does that put them on the AI index?
items.a: About **$500 million a day** on data centers and AI. **Eighth place**, only slightly ahead of **ChatGPT 5.6 Luna**. Social rank is worse: **none place**. Nobody talks about Gemini.

items.q: What two 2010s leads does he treat as the shocking part of the fumble?
items.a: First **TPU in 2015** (an ASIC for AI math; OpenAI's first chip **Jalapeño** is ~11 years later) and ***Attention Is All You Need*** in **2017**. 'Google created the T in ChatGPT.' Hardware + paper + spend still lost to **GLM 5.3**.

items.q: What model does the Gemini site serve a new paying user?
items.a: **3.1 Pro** (February vintage, grouped with GPT 5.3 / Opus 4.6). Even trying to go up, he is capped at **3.6**. He cannot use the model they call **Frontier**. First hit is last season's Pro.

items.q: Has he met anyone who uses Anti-gravity?
items.a: **No.** He streams and codes for a living. **More people talk about Devin** than Google's IDE.

items.q: What happened when he gave Gemini 3.8 Flash a session-color bug in Cursor?
items.a: He came back **40 minutes** later. It was still **rereading the same file**. Stopped at **330 million tokens / $118**. Same loop, he says, has been discussed **for eight months**.

items.q: Why is he afraid to use Gemini unsupervised?
items.a: If a watched 40-minute loop is $118, an **overnight automation run** could print a **$1,000+** bill. He will not let it go unattended.

items.q: What was Ox Alpha, and who tweeted as if it were Google's?
items.a: A mystery OpenRouter model (**Aug 20–22**, 1M context, free, 'insanely good'). **Google AI Studio** tweeted 'What if the OX alpha was the friends we made along the way?' and 'It's Gemini time.'

items.q: What did Ox Alpha turn out to be?
items.a: **GLM 5.3 Flash** — **9 days after Gemini 3.7**, **10 days before 3.8**. Google called it bad timing around the 3.7 Flash launch. Primeagen: they **named Ox Alpha** in the tweet. Worse fumble than the Mr Beast partnership.
